text:
amy: Quick sync: Redwood <> Atlas marketplace + integration launch. Need a concise execution runbook, inbound lead routing, and promo timeline. Thinking webinar + joint blog + benchmark post. Who can take lead on assets? :rocket:

jordan: I can lead webinar logistics + co-write the blog. Tentative webinar: 2026-05-05 09:00 PT. Proposed flow: 10m intro, 15m demo, 10m benchmarks, 20m customer Q&A.

sam_t: I'll generate the benchmark pack and methodology. Will need access to perf buckets and test scripts. Planning to include latency percentiles, throughput curves, and cost/token estimates. :bar_chart:

leila_m: I'll build the landing page + lead form. Two CTAs: Request demo / Start trial. Need partner logos (PNG + SVG), 75-word blurb, and speaker bios. Prefer lightweight privacy checkbox on the form. :sparkles:

naya: For SFDC routing, proposal below — want to confirm fields and queue mapping.

salesops-bot: 
```
source: atlas.marketplace
campaign: "Atlas Integration Launch"
assign_to_queue: Atlas_Inbound
utm: utm_source=atlas_marketplace&utm_campaign=atlas_launch
custom_tags: ["partner:atlas", "partner_integration"]
```

naya: We'll also add a checkbox to the form to capture opt-in and map that to compliant_marketing=true. SalesOps will create the campaign in SFDC and share the campaign id here.

partner-ops: Atlas contact: Priya Rao (priya@atlas.io). They can share logo assets, one customer quote (approved), and a co-authored 75-word product blurb. Priya asked for a press snippet by 2026-04-07.

amy: Action owners: webinar + deck -> jordan; blog + social -> jordan + leila_m; landing page + form -> leila_m; benchmarks + appendix -> sam_t; SFDC routing & QA -> naya + salesops-bot; partner comms -> partner-ops. I'll assemble the runbook after you confirm dates.

jordan: Deliverables: webinar deck first draft by 2026-04-10; blog outline by 2026-04-12; demo script sign-off by 2026-04-14. Need product to provision a partner test account for screenshots.

product-bot: To request partner test account, run `/req-test-account atlas` in #devops. Typical provisioning ~48 hours. For urgent requests ping @devops. :robot_face:

sam_t: Confirmed. Perf graphs + raw CSVs + methodology appendix by 2026-04-13. Will include reproducible commands and seed configs.

leila_m: Landing page draft by 2026-04-11. Can we reuse the marketplace listing template to speed dev? Also drafting two headline options: 
1) "Redwood + Atlas: High-performance LLM Serving on Atlas Marketplace"
2) "Ship Low-latency LLMs on Atlas with Redwood Inference"
Short/social headline for promos and a longer how-to post for docs. Thoughts?

naya: Prefer #1 on social. Use the benchmark as the subhead. Also recommend we capture lead source hidden field on the form.

partner-ops: We'll deliver logos + blurb by 2026-04-08 and a vetted customer quote to use in the blog/webinar. Priya tentatively OK for 2026-05-05 webinar; she'll confirm once calendar invite lands.

amy: Can everyone confirm ETAs in thread pls? I'll run a blockers review next sync on Thu 2026-04-06 10:00 PT and post the runbook link. :calendar:

jordan: Confirmed. Also request: who can act as moderator for the webinar Q&A? Prefer someone from partnerships or product.

leila_m: I can moderate if needed. Also will own the social schedule: LinkedIn, X, partner channels. Will draft 3 social variations and 1 long-form blog.

naya: I'll set up the SFDC campaign and create a QA test flow. Please share a CSV of 10 test leads for mapping verification by 2026-04-14.

salesops-bot: TODO: Create campaign "Atlas Integration Launch" in SFDC and post campaign id here once available. I'll also provision the Atlas_Inbound queue and test assignment rules.

sam_t: Infra ping: infra@redwood - please grant read access to perf bucket for sam_t and a dev role for the test runner. Need this to reproduce charts.

amy: Thanks all. I'll drop the runbook link after the 4/6 sync. If anything slips, flag it here so we adjust timeline. :thumbsup:
